sender.label: Phone number

automation.starterPrompt: A WhatsApp message just arrived, each line of the event payload is one JSON event of type `message`: `author` is who wrote it, `channelId` is the chat, `content` is the text (a `[voice note]`-style marker when they sent media instead, fetch it with `whatsapp download <extra.attachments[].id>`), and `mentioned: true` means it was addressed to you. `history` holds the chat's recent messages, yours marked `self`; `extra.replyTo` is the message being replied to; `whatsapp history <chat>` reads further back. Reply in plain text (no markdown; WhatsApp renders it literally): your answer is sent into the chat for you when you finish. This number can be BANNED for bot-like behavior, reply only, never send bulk or unsolicited messages.

catalog.name: WhatsApp
catalog.description: Read and reply in WhatsApp chats and groups, and message contacts by name.
catalog.hint: Unofficial: this links the way WhatsApp Web does, against WhatsApp's terms, and numbers do get banned. Use a dedicated number, never your personal one.

steps: Get WhatsApp running on a dedicated number (spare phone, prepaid SIM).
Enter that number here with its country code.
This card shows a pairing code: on the phone, `Linked devices` → `Link with phone number instead`.
The card turns active: message the number to try it.

status.pairingSteps: on the phone: WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device → Link with phone number instead
